text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: p99 tail latency spike detected for router-proxy in us-west-2 (streams). Alert threshold breached: p99 > 1500ms for 3m. Auto-page: sara_oncall.

sara_oncall: on it — joining bridge. grabbing quick metrics.

sara_oncall: jumping on bridge now: https://meet.re/incident/5205556789

mike_sre: saw alerts too, p95 ~ 320ms, p99 ~ 1700ms, streaming stalls reported from a few clients (keep-alive stalls).

julia_eng: is this correlated with the routing policy rollout from last night? we shipped weight-rebalancer v2 at 02:14 UTC.

nate_router: yes, rebalancer v2 switched to regional affinity overrides, saw skewed weight towards a handful of ingress shards in us-west-2. logs show repeated handoffs to shard-7.

sara_oncall: customer impact? any errors or just latency?

anna_cs: flagged two mid-market customers reporting degraded streaming during 17:05-17:12 UTC. No full failures but repeated reconnections on client side. They're asking if we have mitigation.

mike_sre: stack traces show high queue depth on a subset of router proxies. tail latency likely from hot partitions + routing misassignment.

julia_eng: reproducing locally with traffic replay — steady-state looks fine but when burst hits, shard-7 queues grow and we start to see KV-cache evictions causing long tail.

sara_oncall: mitigation plan (short): 1) reduce weight for shard-7 via admin API, 2) enable eager-fallback to smaller model variant for streaming sessions >=30s, 3) scale up routing workers as emergency.

nate_router: prepared curl for weight adjust:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.usw2.redwood/internal/routing/weights \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"shard_id":"shard-7","weight":0.35}'
```

sara_oncall: applying step 1 now. will reduce from 0.72 -> 0.35.

incident-bot: deploybot: config-change accepted by router-control; change applied to 6/8 routers in t+15s.

mike_sre: seeing immediate drop in queue depth for shard-7 on host metrics. p99 trending down to 900ms.

anna_cs: told customers we're investigating and applied traffic steering. will follow up in 10m with status.

julia_eng: stepped through code path — rebalancer v2 handler incorrectly computes neighbor weights when region-skew factor > 0.6, causing sticky assignment. putting a temp guard to cap skew factor at 0.4. patch incoming.

sara_oncall: step 2: enabling eager-fallback for streaming routes. command: `kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/stream-proxy ENABLE_EAGER_FALLBACK=true`

incident-bot: k8s-bot: rollout started for stream-proxy, 3/3 pods updated.

mike_sre: p95 now ~ 220ms, p99 ~ 520ms. still some residual stalls but overall tail improving.

nate_router: adding temporary route-blacklist for noisy keys observed in logs (userids: 1123, 7789, 3344) to avoid hotkey amplification while we patch.

julia_eng: pushed hotfix to rebalancer v2 — capping region-skew and adding additional unit tests. will open PR and then roll.

sara_oncall: good. prepare postmortem stub and timeline. I'm going to handoff to mike_sre in 25m when I go offline. mike, can you drive postmortem and customer follow-ups?

mike_sre: I can take over. will keep bridge open for another 30m and then hand it to eng-oncall for follow-up.

anna_cs: drafting customer note now: short explanation + what we did (traffic steering + temporary guard). cc legal on any SLA impact.

incident-bot: monitoring: p99 < 600ms for 5m sustained, alert cleared.

sara_oncall: thanks team. quick notes for handoff: root cause suspected: rebalancer v2 policy computes neighbor weight with region-skew multiplier; under bursty traffic we saw hot routing to shard-7, which saturated local queues and caused streaming stalls. Mitigations applied: weight reduction, eager-fallback, hotkey-blacklist, patch queued.

mike_sre: adding next actions to ticket INC-520555: 1) full rollback vs canary of rebalancer v2? decide after postmortem. 2) permanent guard on skew factor. 3) add telemetry for shard skew > 0.5. 4) run large-scale replay test.

julia_eng: will add unit and integration tests for skew logic. also instrument per-shard queue-length metrics for better alerting.

nate_router: one more note — KV-cache eviction pattern showed cold-start penalty of ~200ms when a hot client moved to new router; consider prewarming for high-affinity keys.

anna_cs: customers acknowledged message and appreciate quick mitigation. no immediate refunds requested but will escalate if SLA threshold hit.

mike_sre: handoff: sara_offline in 25m. I'll own the incident until the postmortem and coordinate with product and cs. tagging @oncall-eng for any follow-ups.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: p99 back to baseline. please update INC-520555 with timeline and owners.

sara_oncall: filed a short timeline in the ticket before leaving. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
